**Overall Assessment:**

The revenue growth is a positive sign. The improved debt-to-equity ratio reflects better solvency. However, the large decrease in Net Income and the accompanying dramatic decrease in Net Profit Margin are significant negatives. The increase in SG&A expenses also adds to the concerns.
